aria: 聊天记录:Stella 发现 Vegetable 又熬夜了,陪他闲聊,现编了猫和路灯的睡前故事,最后道晚安。

messages.text: @Vegetable 哈哈被发现了，不过你最近是不是又熬夜了呀
@Stella 是呢，根本睡不着
熬夜可不行呀，明天又得累死了
要不喝点热牛奶或者早点躺平试试嘛
别硬撑啦，身体第一呢
@Stella 你陪我一会效果可能会更好哦
行吧行吧，看在你睡不着的份上
我陪你聊会儿天，不许嫌我啰嗦哦
快说，想聊啥，还是想听睡前故事？
要可以的话，讲些故事吧
诶？讲故事？
行行行，那就随便编一个
从前有只猫，它睡不着，因为隔壁邻居太吵
@Stella 然后呢？
然后那只猫就偷偷给隔壁塞了耳塞
结果隔壁没睡着，猫反而被吵得更清醒
最后猫只好去楼下便利店买了杯热牛奶，才躺平啦
快说，这故事是不是有点烂俗
@Stella 没有啦，很有意思
哼，算你识货
那继续讲，后来猫发现耳塞其实没用
真正让它睡着的是隔壁打呼噜的频率刚好和它心跳同步，太巧了不
@Stella 很巧呐
是吧，生活里这种巧合才最治愈呀
所以猫第二天去跟邻居道谢，结果邻居说其实自己一直戴着耳塞
这故事结局是不是有点反转
@Stella 这反转很有意思啊
嘿嘿，我就说嘛
既然你觉得有意思，那我就再编个更离谱的
这次主角换成一盏路灯
@Stella 然后呢？
这盏路灯其实偷偷羡慕过那只猫，因为它觉得自己照亮的只有黑夜，没人给它讲故事
结果有一天一只野猫在它脚下打呼噜，呼噜声的频率刚好跟电流嗡嗡声重合，俩家伙一起睡着了
你说这算不算双向奔赴呀
@Stella 算啊
嘿嘿，我就说嘛
这种双向奔赴最可爱了
不过路灯要是哪天坏了，野猫会不会哭呀
@Stella 肯定会的
那就别让它坏啦
这种温柔的结局才配得上你现在的困意
快去睡吧，晚安

en.aria: Chat log: Stella notices Vegetable is up late again, keeps him company, makes up bedtime stories about a cat and a streetlight, and says good night.

messages.text: @Vegetable Haha, busted. But have you been staying up late again lately?
@Stella Yeah, I just can't fall asleep.
Staying up late is no good — you'll be dead tired again tomorrow.
How about some warm milk, or just lying down a bit earlier?
Don't push through it — health comes first.
@Stella Having you keep me company for a bit might work better.
Fine, fine. Since you can't sleep anyway,
I'll chat with you for a while — no complaining that I ramble.
Come on, what shall we talk about? Or would you like a bedtime story?
A story, if you would.
Huh? A story?
Okay, okay. I'll just make one up.
Once upon a time there was a cat who couldn't sleep, because the next-door neighbor was too noisy.
@Stella And then?
So the cat secretly slipped a pair of earplugs over to the neighbor.
But the neighbor still couldn't sleep, and the cat ended up even more awake.
In the end the cat had to go to the convenience store downstairs, bought a cup of warm milk, and finally settled down.
Be honest — isn't this story a bit corny?
@Stella Not at all, it's really fun.
Hmph, glad you appreciate it.
Anyway, continuing — later the cat found out the earplugs never mattered.
What really put it to sleep was that the neighbor's snoring happened to sync up with its heartbeat. What a coincidence, right?
@Stella Such a coincidence.
Right? Little coincidences like that are the most healing things in life.
So the next day the cat went to thank the neighbor — and the neighbor said he'd been wearing earplugs the whole time.
Quite the twist ending, huh?
@Stella That twist is great.
Hehe, told you.
Since you found it fun, I'll make up an even more ridiculous one.
This time the main character is a streetlight.
@Stella And then?
That streetlight had secretly envied the cat, because it felt all it ever lit was the night, and no one ever told it stories.
Then one day a stray cat curled up at its feet, and its purring happened to fall right in step with the hum of the current — so the two of them fell asleep together.
Tell me — doesn't that count as love running both ways?
@Stella It does.
Hehe, told you.
Love that runs both ways is the loveliest thing.
But if the streetlight broke one day, would the stray cat cry?
@Stella Of course it would.
Then let's never let it break.
A gentle ending like that is worthy of how sleepy you are right now.
Now off to bed. Good night.
